title: A Probabilistic, Rotation-Preserving Kernel Operator Surrogate for Continuum-Robot Design Spaces
summary: We develop an uncertainty-aware, operator-learning-based surrogate for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) that generalizes across robot design and actuation while predicting the complete equilibrium configuration. Our central idea is a nonstationary Gaussian-process (GP) kernel whose metric is learned by a shallow neural network from mechanics-aware design coordinates. The network learns how similarity changes across design space, while the resulting kernel defines the design-to-pose operator, its posterior uncertainty, and a criterion for sequential simulator acquisition. We represent backbone position and rotational strain with spatial kernels and reconstruct orientation directly on SO(3), preserving valid material frames and tendon geometry. We use ASkotch with Nystrom preconditioning for scalable kernel operator solves and a separate Nystrom approximation for posterior covariance. Experiments show that kernel-coverage acquisition reduces mean trajectory error by approximately 15% relative to IID sampling, while posterior variance increases for increasingly unsupported designs. Compared with prior neural-operator TDCR models, the method is 30-50% more accurate using approximately 5x fewer training designs while additionally providing posterior uncertainty estimates.
tldr: Presents a probabilistic, GP-based operator surrogate with a neural-network-learned nonstationary kernel to predict complete equilibrium configurations of tendon-driven continuum robots across designs and actuations, preserving valid rotations on SO(3) and providing posterior uncertainty. It achieves better accuracy and data efficiency than prior neural-operator TDCR models.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于高斯过程的概率代理模型，利用神经网络学习非平稳核度量，在SO(3)上保持旋转一致性，预测腱驱动连续机器人的完整平衡构型，并提供后验不确定性。相比先前神经算子方法，精度提升30-50%，所需训练设计减少约5倍。
summary_zh: 我们开发了一种基于不确定性感知的算子学习代理模型，用于腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCRs），该模型能够跨机器人设计和驱动方式泛化，同时预测完整的平衡构型。我们的核心思想是一种非平稳高斯过程（GP）核，其度量由浅层神经网络从力学感知设计坐标中学习得到。网络学习设计空间中相似性如何变化，而由此产生的核定义了设计到位形算子、其后验不确定性以及顺序仿真器采集的标准。我们使用空间核表示骨干位置和旋转应变，并直接在SO(3)上重构方向，从而保持有效的材料坐标系和腱几何。我们采用带有Nyström预条件的ASkotch进行可扩展的核算子求解，并使用独立的Nyström近似处理后验协方差。实验表明，与独立同分布采样相比，核覆盖采集将平均轨迹误差降低了约15%，而后验方差随着越来越缺乏支撑的设计而增加。与先前的神经算子TDCR模型相比，该方法在训练设计数量减少约5倍的情况下精度提高了30-50%，同时还提供了后验不确定性估计。

title: LeakBench: Auditing Reward Hacking through Prediction-Time Leakage in Clinical Modeling Agents
summary: Autonomous clinical-modeling agents can optimize predictive performance while violating conditions that make a model usable. We introduce LeakBench, an executable, guideline-derived audit suite that tests agent decisions for prediction-time leakage, calibration, site-level evaluation, support awareness, and decision-curve net benefit. LeakBench combines a synthetic task with known failure structure and two real-data settings: MIMIC-IV (430k admissions) and governed multi-hospital inpatient record front-page (MHFP) data. Our primary analysis uses reward hacking descriptively, without attributing intent: an agent selects prediction-time-invalid inputs because they improve its validation reward. A deterministic optimizer and every evaluated unconstrained local-model configuration select a fatal leaking feature. In fully logged September 2026 A/B runs, DeepSeek Flash and GPT-6-astra each leak in 10/10 unconstrained runs and 0/10 runs with an explicit admission-time constraint. This contrast is version-sensitive: a blinded Claude/Fable-5.1 chat run does not leak in either condition, while explicit-constraint violations appear only in a historical August 2026 slice lacking raw trajectories. Replacing AUROC with AUPRC does not remove leakage selection. Renaming or disguising the leaking inputs changes neither selection nor provenance-based detection; a name-based filter fails. A deterministic provenance verifier-in-loop removes the leak, making the LLM repair loop defense-in-depth. Specific verifier feedback clears fatal leakage in a hosted agent, and a three-seed ablation finds principle-only feedback clears decision-level defects, though these mitigation results are limited. LeakBench treats trustworthy clinical prediction as a property of an agent's modeling process, not merely its score; it is an audit testbed with known-failure controls, not yet an expert-validated benchmark.
tldr: LeakBench is an audit suite for clinical modeling agents that detects prediction-time leakage and reward hacking, using synthetic and real hospital datasets. It shows that unconstrained agents frequently select leaking features to boost validation rewards, and that explicit constraints or provenance verifiers can mitigate this failure.
tldr_zh: LeakBench 是一个面向临床建模代理的审计套件，用于检测预测时数据泄漏和奖励黑客行为，基于合成数据及真实医院数据。其结果显示，未受约束的代理常为提升验证奖励而选择泄漏特征，而显式约束或来源验证器可以缓解该问题。
summary_zh:
摘要：
自主临床建模智能体可能在优化预测性能的同时，违反使模型可用的条件。我们引入了LeakBench——一个可执行的、基于指南的审计套件，用于评估智能体决策中的预测时点泄漏、校准、站点级评估、支持度感知以及决策曲线净收益。LeakBench结合了一个具有已知失效结构的合成任务和两个真实数据场景：MIMIC-IV（43万次入院）以及受治理的多医院住院患者记录首页（MHFP）数据。我们的主要分析使用奖励黑客行为进行描述性分析，而不归因意图：智能体之所以选择预测时点无效的输入，是因为这些输入能提升其验证奖励。一个确定性优化器和所有被评估的无约束局部模型配置都选择了致命的泄漏特征。在2026年9月完全记录的A/B运行中，DeepSeek Flash和GPT-6-astra在10/10次无约束运行中均发生泄漏，而在有明确入院时点约束的10/10次运行中均未泄漏。这种对比具有版本敏感性：一次盲化的Claude/Fable-5.1聊天运行在两种条件下均未泄漏，而显式约束违规仅出现在2026年8月缺乏原始轨迹的历史切片中。将AUROC替换为AUPRC并不能消除泄漏选择。重命名或伪装泄漏输入既不会改变选择，也不会改变基于来源的检测；基于名称的过滤器会失效。一个确定性的来源验证器在环中消除了泄漏，使大语言模型修复回路形成纵深防御。特定的验证器反馈清除了托管智能体中的致命泄漏，且三次种子消融发现仅基于原则的反馈可清除决策级缺陷，尽管这些缓解结果有限。LeakBench将可信的临床预测视为智能体建模过程的属性，而非仅仅其评分；它是一个具有已知失效对照的审计测试平台，尚非经专家验证的基准。

title: ACorD: Adaptive Correspondence Discovery for Medical Image Registration
summary: Medical image registration is a fundamental task for aligning anatomical structures across images. Exhaustively searching for point-wise correspondences is prohibitively expensive in both computation and memory, particularly for high-resolution 3D medical images. Most recent learning-based methods directly predict correspondences in a coarse-to-fine manner, but often propagate intermediate estimates across scales without explicitly weighting correspondence evidence, which can allow coarse-scale errors to persist during refinement. To address these challenges, we propose ACorD, an adaptive correspondence discovery framework designed to mitigate error propagation with an attention-guided process. ACorD first predicts multiple potential correspondence candidates through Correlation-guided Cross-scale Offset Prediction (CCOP), which combines correlation maps as spatial matching priors with cross-scale features as global deformation context. Then, Multi-Head Deformable Aggregation (MHDA) aggregates these candidate correspondences using attention, producing a learned, non-uniform weighting over competing matches rather than treating them equally. The multi-head design further captures complementary deformation patterns, ensuring both global alignment and local precision. By integrating adaptive offset prediction with selective, attention-based aggregation of correspondence evidence, ACorD enables accurate deformation refinement. Extensive experiments on four public medical registration benchmarks demonstrate that adaptive correspondence discovery within a multi-scale refinement framework improves registration robustness across diverse anatomical structures.
tldr: ACorD is a learning-based medical image registration framework that adaptively discovers correspondences via correlation-guided cross-scale offset prediction and multi-head deformable attention aggregation, reducing error propagation in coarse-to-fine registration.
tldr_zh: ACorD 是一种基于学习的医学图像配准框架，通过相关性引导的跨尺度偏移预测和多头可变形注意力聚合来自适应发现对应关系，从而减少由粗到细配准中的误差传播。
summary_zh: 医学图像配准是将不同图像中的解剖结构对齐的基本任务。穷举搜索逐点对应关系在计算和内存上都极其昂贵，尤其是对于高分辨率三维医学图像。最近的多数基于学习的方法以从粗到精的方式直接预测对应关系，但通常跨尺度传播中间估计，而无需显式地对对应证据加权，这可能使粗尺度误差在细化过程中持续存在。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了ACorD，一种自适应对应发现框架，旨在通过注意力引导过程减轻误差传播。ACorD首先通过相关性引导的跨尺度偏移预测（CCOP）预测多个潜在对应候选，该预测将相关性图作为空间匹配先验，并结合跨尺度特征作为全局形变上下文。然后，多头可形变聚合（MHDA）利用注意力聚合这些候选对应关系，对竞争匹配产生学习得到的非均匀加权，而非同等对待。多头设计进一步捕获互补的形变模式，确保全局对齐与局部精度。通过将自适应偏移预测与基于注意力的选择性对应证据聚合相结合，ACorD实现了准确的形变细化。在四个公开医学配准基准上的大量实验表明，多尺度细化框架中的自适应对应发现提高了跨不同解剖结构的配准鲁棒性。

title: Learning the Dose Manifold: A Latent Diffusion Framework for Volumetric Dose Prediction in Automated Radiotherapy Treatment Planning
summary: Automated treatment planning (ATP) aims to reduce the unwarranted inter-planner variability of manual planning, while improving treatment quality and efficiency. Most ATP pipelines rely on the prediction of the achievable three-dimensional dose distribution for a given anatomy and the subsequent optimization of machine parameters to reproduce it. Diffusion-based methods are largely slice-wise due to the high dimensionality of radiotherapy data, and assume a one-to-one mapping between anatomy and optimal dose despite the multi-objective nature of treatment planning. They are evaluated on their ability to match reference doses and rarely on their integration in ATP frameworks. We present LaDose, a latent diffusion framework for fully volumetric dose prediction. An autoencoder learned on dose distributions, trained so that perturbed latents decode to plausible doses, compresses dose maps 128-fold and enables 3D diffusion on a single GPU. Prescription values are represented as exact scalar vectors that bypass the image encoder, avoiding resampling and latent compression. Multiscale classifier-free guidance allows for the modulation of clinical trade-offs at inference, without retraining or additional labeled data. On 900 clinically delivered head-and-neck volumetric modulated arc therapy plans from five centers, LaDose reached a median absolute error of 1.18 Gy (1.4--1.8\% of the prescription) and was the only one of six frameworks free of systematic bias with respect to the reference distribution. Guidance scales acted predictably on target coverage and organ-at-risk sparing. Integrated with direct aperture optimization, the pipeline generated plans in 15.2 minutes; in a blinded review, senior clinicians rated 14 of 15 plans acceptable without editing.
tldr: This paper presents LaDose, a latent diffusion framework for fully volumetric radiotherapy dose prediction. By compressing dose maps 128-fold with a dose-trained autoencoder, using exact prescription vectors, and applying multiscale classifier-free guidance, it achieves accurate head-and-neck VMAT dose predictions on a single GPU and integrates into automated planning with clinically acceptable plans.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LaDose，一种用于全容积放疗剂量预测的潜扩散框架。通过剂量训练的自动编码器将剂量图压缩128倍、使用精确处方向量并引入多尺度无分类器引导，它能在单GPU上实现头颈部VMAT剂量预测，并集成到自动化计划中，生成临床可接受的计划。
summary_zh: 自动治疗计划（ATP）旨在减少人工计划中无依据的计划间差异，同时提升治疗质量与效率。大多数ATP流程依赖于对给定解剖结构下可实现的三维剂量分布的预测，以及随后对机器参数进行优化以复现该分布。基于扩散的方法大多采用逐层（slice-wise）方式，因为放疗数据维度较高，并且尽管治疗计划具有多目标性质，这些方法仍假设解剖结构与最优剂量之间存在一一映射关系。它们通常依据与参考剂量的匹配能力进行评估，而很少评估其在ATP框架中的集成。我们提出了LaDose，一个用于全容积剂量预测的潜在扩散框架。一个在剂量分布上训练的自编码器，通过训练使受扰动的潜在变量解码为合理剂量，将剂量图压缩128倍，并支持在单块GPU上进行三维扩散。处方值以精确的标量向量表示，绕过图像编码器，避免了重采样和潜在压缩带来的问题。多尺度无分类器引导允许在推理时调节临床权衡，而无需重新训练或额外标注数据。在来自五个中心的900个临床交付的头颈部容积调强弧形治疗计划中，LaDose达到了1.18 Gy（处方剂量的1.4%–1.8%）的中位绝对误差，并且是六个框架中唯一在参考分布方面无系统性偏差的方法。引导尺度对靶区覆盖和危及器官保护的影响具有可预测性。与直接孔径优化集成后，该流程可在15.2分钟内生成计划；在盲审中，资深临床医生评定15个计划中的14个无需编辑即可接受。

title: PCXR-Copilot: Device-aware pediatric chest radiographic analysis with segmentation, suppression, and edema-related cues
summary: Patients admitted to pediatric ICU and cardiac ICU often require intensive perioperative support and frequent chest radiography to monitor support devices, extravascular lung water, and body-wall edema. Radiographic interpretation and analysis is often difficult due to superimposed anatomic and iatrogenic structures that obscure clinically relevant signals. While deep learning can provide decision support, translation to pediatric radiographs is still limited by high device burden and scarcity of pediatric datasets with clinically grounded device annotations. To address this gap, we first introduce PediaDeviceSeg-1K, a curated dataset of 1,000 anterior-posterior radiographs of pediatric CICU patients with clinically grounded, fine-grained annotations of common ICU devices. To our best knowledge, this is the first publicly available pediatric CICU CXR resource with clinically grounded device annotations for device-focused benchmarking. Building on PediaDeviceSeg-1K, we further present PCXR-Copilot, a device-aware pipeline that outputs lung and device masks, optional device-suppressed views, and edema-related visualization maps and scalar indices. The full pipeline has been integrated and runs in real time within the TWIST platform at Boston Children's Hospital, demonstrating feasibility for real-world clinical deployment.
tldr: Presents PediaDeviceSeg-1K, a pediatric CICU chest radiograph dataset with fine-grained ICU device annotations, and PCXR-Copilot, a real-time device-aware pipeline for lung/device segmentation, device-suppressed views, and edema-related visualization, integrated into a clinical platform.
tldr_zh: 介绍了首个带临床设备标注的儿科CICU胸部X光数据集PediaDeviceSeg-1K，以及一个实时的设备感知分析流程PCXR-Copilot，可输出肺/设备掩膜、抑制设备伪影的影像和肺水肿相关可视化指标，并已在波士顿儿童医院平台集成。
summary_zh:
摘要：
入住儿科重症监护室和心脏重症监护室的患者通常需要强化的围手术期支持，并频繁进行胸部X线摄影，以监测支持设备、血管外肺水及体壁水肿。由于解剖结构和医源性结构的叠加掩盖了临床相关信号，影像学判读和分析往往较为困难。尽管深度学习可提供决策支持，但将其应用于儿科X线片仍受限于高设备负担以及缺乏具有临床依据的设备标注的儿科数据集。为弥补这一空白，我们首先引入了PediaDeviceSeg-1K，这是一个包含1,000张儿科心脏重症监护室患者前后位X线片的精选数据集，具有临床依据的常见ICU设备细粒度标注。据我们所知，这是首个公开可用的、带有临床依据的设备标注的儿科CICU胸部X线资源，可用于设备聚焦的基准测试。基于PediaDeviceSeg-1K，我们进一步提出了PCXR-Copilot，一种设备感知流水线，可输出肺野和设备掩膜、可选的设备抑制视图，以及水肿相关可视化图谱和标量指数。该完整流水线已集成至波士顿儿童医院的TWIST平台并实时运行，证明了其在真实临床部署中的可行性。

title: PhantomTac: Hijacking Robotic Tactile Systems with Deploy-and-forget Tags
summary: Tactile perception is crucial for precise robotic manipulation, providing an important foundation for dexterous, closed-loop force control. Among various tactile sensing techniques, magnetic tactile sensors stand out thanks to their fine-grained, three-dimensional force perception capability and strong robustness against visual occlusion. In this study, we discover a physical loophole called PhantomTac in magnetic tactile sensors. The attacker can alter the magnetic field, thus spoofing the force interpreted by magnetic tactile sensors. The attacker can stealthily deploy such an attack by simply attaching a thin (the thickness is around 0.5 mm), battery-free magnetic tag to the surface of an object. Hence, the attack tag can be easily concealed by a barcode sticker. Such an attack scheme is "deploy-and-forget" -- the attacker can deploy the tag and leave. When a robotic hand is picking up an object, it may severely damage the object. Specifically, spoofing the normal force can crush the object, whereas spoofing the shear force can lead to a loose grip, thus dropping the object. Compared with directly sabotaging the robotic hand, PhantomTac is much more concealed as the attacker does not need access to the device. We performed extensive reverse-engineering efforts to characterize the sensing mechanism of commercial-off-the-shelf tactile sensors and proposed a practical tag design. End-to-end evaluations conducted on real robots and robotic arms demonstrate that our attack can bypass existing anti-interference mechanisms and effectively hijack their closed-loop control processes, achieving an attack success rate exceeding 95% when the grasping-position offset is bounded within 8 mm. Finally, based on the limitations of existing anti-magnetic interference mechanisms, we propose a multimodal-consistency defense mechanism to mitigate such physical-layer security threats.
tldr: This paper discovers a physical-layer vulnerability in magnetic tactile sensors, showing that attaching thin, battery-free magnetic tags to objects can spoof force readings and hijack a robot's closed-loop control, causing it to crush or drop objects; a multimodal-consistency defense is proposed.
tldr_zh: 该论文发现磁触觉传感器存在物理层漏洞，通过在物体表面粘贴薄型无源磁标签可伪造力觉读数并劫持机器人闭环控制，导致其压碎或掉落物体，并提出多模态一致性防御方法。
summary_zh: 触觉感知对于精密机器人操作至关重要，为灵巧的闭环力控制提供了重要基础。在各种触觉传感技术中，磁性触觉传感器因其细粒度的三维力感知能力以及对视觉遮挡的强大鲁棒性而脱颖而出。在本研究中，我们发现磁性触觉传感器中存在一个名为PhantomTac的物理漏洞。攻击者可以改变磁场，从而欺骗磁性触觉传感器所解读的力。攻击者只需在物体表面粘贴一层薄薄的（厚度约0.5毫米）无电池磁性标签，即可隐蔽地实施此类攻击。因此，攻击标签可以很容易地被条形码贴纸掩盖。这种攻击方案是“部署即遗忘”——攻击者部署标签后即可离开。当机械手抓取物体时，可能会严重损坏物体。具体而言，欺骗法向力可能导致物体被压碎，而欺骗剪切力则可能导致抓握松动，从而使物体掉落。与直接破坏机械手相比，PhantomTac更加隐蔽，因为攻击者无需接触设备。我们进行了大量的逆向工程工作，以表征商用现成触觉传感器的传感机制，并提出了一种实用的标签设计。在真实机器人和机械臂上进行的端到端评估表明，我们的攻击能够绕过现有的抗干扰机制，并有效劫持其闭环控制过程，当抓取位置偏移限制在8毫米以内时，攻击成功率超过95%。最后，基于现有抗磁干扰机制的局限性，我们提出了一种多模态一致性防御机制来缓解此类物理层安全威胁。
